name: Cross-View Consistent Loss
definition: A loss function that penalizes discrepancies between the residuals of paired views, weighted by their structural similarity, to enforce global coherence and mitigate Gaussian overfitting.
summary: Cross-View Consistent Loss enforces geometric coherence in Gaussian Splatting by penalizing weighted residual discrepancies between adjacent views, distinguishing itself by leveraging structural similarity to ensure consistent error patterns.
